datasets.title: GPU cluster performance
datasets.description: Share of global GPU cluster (AI supercomputer) performance by country, May 2025, from Epoch AI. The US share is published as about three quarters.

datasets.title: AI compute by country
datasets.description: Share of AI chip compute (H100-equivalents) acquired since 2022, as of Q2 2026, from Epoch AI's AI Chip Imports explorer.

datasets.title: Azure measured latency
datasets.description: Median (P50) round-trip latency between Azure regions over the 30 days to 30 July 2026, measured by Azure's backbone probes. Latency is directional.

datasets.title: Submarine cables (2021 snapshot)
datasets.description: Cable systems in TeleGeography's Submarine Cable Map as of its January 2021 open-data snapshot: length, ready-for-service year, owners and the countries each one lands in (separated by |).

datasets.title: Submarine cables today
datasets.description: TeleGeography's current headline figures for the global submarine cable network.

datasets.title: Cloud regions
datasets.description: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud regions as listed by each provider, plotted at a representative city in the named area.

datasets.title: Country codes
datasets.description: Countries in the cable data matched to Natural Earth map shapes (ISO 3166 numeric). Small islands have no shape at this map scale.

datasets.title: Data centre electricity
datasets.description: Electricity used by data centres: global and regional (IEA), United States (LBNL) and Ireland (CSO).

datasets.title: Cable landing points (2021 snapshot)
datasets.description: Landing points in TeleGeography's January 2021 open-data snapshot.

datasets.title: Top supercomputers
datasets.description: Systems from the June 2026 TOP500 top ten whose site is named in the source.

datasets.title: TOP500 systems by country
datasets.description: Number of systems on the June 2026 TOP500 list.

datasets.title: Data centre water
datasets.description: Water consumed by data centres in the United States (LBNL estimate) and by Google and Meta's data centres, 2023.
